images.title: 平台主智能体
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE realistic production-quality desktop Dobby Chinese agent management UI screenshot, 1440 x 1024 pixels, no device or browser chrome, no collage. This is one state in a coherent design suite, not an alternative direction.
References: first reference is selected design anchor, second shows required capability categories, third shows existing modal to preserve functionality. Preserve white/offwhite surfaces, charcoal text, burnt orange #C95622 accents, fine gray rules, professional outlined icons, generous spacing. Chinese sans-serif Microsoft YaHei style. Text 14–16px body; all text at least 12px. No gradients, decorative illustrations, invented metrics, giant welcome text, busy cards inside cards.
CRITICAL navigation: full-height 208px left sidebar, Dobby 管理中心 logo/header. TWO DISTINCT primary menu entries: 平台主智能体 first; 业务工具 second. They are separate destinations, NEVER a combined menu, segmented toggle, or tabs for these two. Then 记忆与学习, 运行记录, 定时任务; lower 基础配置 group: 模型与连接, 外部知识库, 系统配置. Native AgentScope 知识库 tab is hidden; external knowledge permission must remain. Four FIXED platform roles Dobby 总控, 项目初始化, 任务助手, 资料助手. Main agent page has NO new/delete-role action. Business tools page alone has 新增业务工具.
Keep one clear focus per frame. Editing forms belong in a properly elevated CENTERED modal over a dimmed page; capabilities open a dedicated modal; debug opens a large independent overlay. Do not stuff every form into the outer page. One modal at a time, title and footer fixed, independent body scrollbar if necessary. No nested modal stacks.
This is a design illustration, not evidence of live permissions or tests; show small unobtrusive 设计稿 in header. No dates necessary; current date anchor 2026-09-08. The chosen existing visual style must remain consistent across every frame.
